numbering: Episodes numbered continuously across both seasons: Noragami 1-12 and Aragoto 13-25 (OVAs unnumbered).

arcs.name: The Stray God
arcs.summary: Yato, a minor god without a shrine, takes any job for five yen. After he saves schoolgirl Hiyori from a bus, her soul starts slipping out of her body, and she pesters him to fix it.
events: Hiyori becomes a half-phantom whose spirit leaves her body at random.
Yato takes in the dead boy's spirit Yukine as his regalia weapon.
Hiyori learns that Yato was once a god of calamity.

arcs.name: Yukine's Blight
arcs.summary: An old enemy comes after Yato just as Yukine's resentment over being dead starts to poison his master.
events: The war god Bishamon attacks Yato over a long-held grudge.
Yukine's stealing and bitterness blight Yato until he collapses.
Yukine is put through a purifying ablution and finally apologizes to Yato.

arcs.name: Rabo
arcs.summary: An anime-original finale in which a figure from Yato's bloody past resurfaces.
events: Nora steals Hiyori's memories of Yato and Yukine.
The revived god-slayer Rabo tests Yato's strength.
Yato defeats Rabo, and Hiyori recovers her memories and chooses to stay with him.

arcs.name: Bishamon
arcs.summary: Bishamon's family of regalia begins to crack under a traitor's schemes, pulling Yato's group into her tragic history.
events: A schemer among Bishamon's regalia, Kugaha, kills Suzuha and turns her family against her.
Kazuma's tie to Yato and Bishamon's past is revealed.
Yukine evolves into a Blessed Vessel to protect Yato.
Yato and Bishamon finally make peace.

arcs.name: Ebisu and the Underworld
arcs.summary: The god of fortune Ebisu takes an interest in Yukine, while Yato's mysterious father pulls strings behind the scenes.
events: Hiyori builds Yato a tiny shrine of his own.
Yato's father reappears and Yato disappears.
Yato travels into the Underworld to rescue Ebisu from Izanami.
Ebisu is reborn as a child, and Yato renounces his days as a god of calamity.

filler.note: No filler episodes, but episode 10 is mixed and episodes 11-12 are an anime-original ending to season 1.
